artworks.title: Meeting of Margaret of Austria and Philip III
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a formal court scene featuring multiple figures in elaborate clothing. The setting is an indoor scene that depicts a gathering of figures dressed in what appears to be Renaissance attire. They are positioned around a central platform, with some standing on it and others around it. The figures are adorned in ornate clothing with detailed ruffles and jewelry. There is an intricate canopy overhead. The artist has employed a detailed linework technique to illustrate the folds in the garments and the facial expressions of the figures.

artworks.title: Arrival at Valencia
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The illustration shows a procession of people walking towards the right side. The individuals have serious expressions, with men having short hair and women having elaborate hairstyles. They wear ornate clothing typical of a historical setting, featuring ruffled collars and rich patterns. A man in the foreground wears a wide-brimmed hat and a decorated cloak. Some individuals are leading a horse with decorative harness. In the background, there are tall buildings, arched entrances, turrets, and a ship on the left side.

artworks.title: Embarkation at Genoa
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image displays seven individuals in historic attire standing near the water. The central figure, facing left, extends their right hand forward. They are wearing an ornate gown with a ruff around their neck. Surrounding them are six other individuals, also in historical clothing. Some hold objects, with one holding a scroll. The background shows the sea with waves, boats, and a fortress-like structure in the distance under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Reception at Mantua
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people engaging in a greeting or exchange. The individuals are standing and facing each other, with some performing gestures typical of interaction. The individuals have distinct facial features and are dressed in traditional, historical clothing with accessories. The background suggests an outdoor setting with abstract lines indicating clouds and open space.

artworks.title: Papal Audience
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a formal audience in a historical context. The image shows a group of figures gathered in an interior setting. The figures are dressed in elaborate, period-specific attire. Most figures are standing, while one figure is kneeling. The setting includes architectural elements like an archway, and additional background details are present. The central composition focuses on interactions among the figures, indicating a hierarchical or ceremonious event.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria Receiving the Homage of Cardinals and Prelates
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures standing in a line. The drawing depicts a group of elegantly dressed figures gathered together. The central figures wear elaborate robes and gowns, indicating a setting of significance or high status. The background showcases a textured wall or curtain. The presence of various garments and cloaks adds to the atmosphere of opulence and solemnity. The artist uses fine lines and hatching to convey depth and detail, while the absence of color emphasizes the contrast and texture within the drawing.

artworks.title: The Betrothal of Margaret of Austria to Philip III, King of Spain
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals gathered on and around steps in an interior setting. The central figures seem to be engaged in a conversation, with one figure slightly bending forward. Others around them are dressed in historical European fashion, with some wearing head coverings. A woman holds a child to the right of the central figures, and additional figures are nearby. The background features columns and arches, suggesting a formal space.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria Being Carried in a Chaise
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: It is a drawing of a historical scene with people gathered around a seated figure. In the scene, several figures are depicted engaging with a central figure who is seated under a large, decorated umbrella or canopy. The figures standing around are dressed in robes, cloaks, and period costumes. There are pole weapons in the background. The style of the drawing reflects detailed line work and shading typical of engravings or illustrations from historical texts.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria on Horseback
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession. The image shows a group of figures on horseback dressed in ornate historical attire. The horses are detailed with elegant tack and ornaments. One of the riders is under a parasol, indicating importance. The illustration is dense with details of uniforms and equipment, giving a sense of movement and grandeur. Fine lines and cross-hatching techniques are used to create depth and texture in the drawing.

artworks.title: Philip of Spain Before Margaret of Austria
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The engraving features multiple figures in historical attire. Most figures are shown from the waist up, with two men on each side shown in full. In the center, a kneeling man is depicted in profile, bowing slightly with one arm extended. He wears a cape and knee-length pants, with a ruffled collar. To the left, a woman stands elevated on a step, wearing an elaborately patterned gown and an intricate ruff. Her hair is styled elegantly. Across from her, several observers stand in a line, mostly women in similar long gowns with ruffled collars. The men also wear cloaks, doublets, and decorative collars, holding cylindrical objects. The scene is indoors, indicated by a paneled background suggestive of a grand hall.

artworks.title: Philip II of Spain on His Throne
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows five men in a room. The central figure on the left is seated in a chair, one leg crossed over the other. The seated individual has a thick beard and wears a hat, a high-collared cape, and a tunic with vertical stripes. The standing man in front of him holds a document or scroll and is dressed in similar period attire with a doublet, ruff, and short cape, carrying a sword at his side. Behind him, three other men are visible; one holds a scribe or documentation, while the other two look engaged in conversation. Their faces are detailed with period-specific hairstyles and ruffs, and they are dressed in high-collared cloaks and hose. The man closest to the viewer on the right holds a hat and a walking cane. The scene takes place in a room with draped curtains and a window letting in light, adding depth to the monochrome image.

artworks.title: Triumphal Entry of Margaret of Austria
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a parade scene. The image shows a procession under an architectural archway. Several figures are dressed in elaborate attire. The forefront features figures leading horses, one holding a canopy over another seated on a horse. The background shows arches and a large gathering of people. The scene is detailed with period-appropriate clothing and a sense of movement towards the background.

artworks.title: Italian Prince before Margaret of Austria
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a formal gathering or meeting. A group of figures in historical costumes stand in a stately room. They are engaging with each other, with some possibly delivering or receiving a message. The setting includes a large wooden door in the background. The style is reminiscent of classical European engravings, with detailed line work and careful depiction of clothing and proportions.

artworks.title: Spanish Duke before Margaret of Austria
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows several individuals in historical attire. In the center, a person sits on an ornate throne-like chair, dressed in an elaborate gown with intricate patterns, and a high, ruffled collar. By their side, another individual sits on steps in a robe with their head covered. A man kneels before the seated figures, holding a hat, and is dressed in ruffled attire with a cape. Surrounding individuals wear similar period clothing, including capes and doublets with large collars. In the background, there is a tower-like architectural element and ships with raised masts. The scene is set with a drawn curtain above the main figures.

artworks.title: Margaret of Austria Giving Audience to a Nobleman
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated royal figure surrounded by attendants. The drawing depicts a scene with a group of individuals in historical attire gathered around a central figure seated on a throne or elevated platform. The central figure appears to be regal, wearing a crown, and the others, both standing and bowing, exhibit gestures of deference or presentation. The clothing of all figures is elaborate, draped with robes and ruffs, suggestive of a renaissance or early modern European setting. The linear style and hatch shading provide the image with a detailed texture, and the architectural elements in the background, such as the paneled wall, add to the formality of the setting.

artworks.title: Philip as a Boy before Margaret of Austria
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a historical scene with several individuals in elaborate clothing from a bygone era. The people are engaged in a formal event or ceremony, with notable figures positioned prominently in the center. One central figure is holding a child, wrapped and cradled. Surrounding this central action are multiple men in robes and garments typical of clergy, with broad collars and long, flowing attire. The central clergy figure is wearing a hat that suggests high rank, possibly a bishop. The individuals have sharply defined facial features and serious expressions. The clothing is ornate, featuring detailed textures and designs like buttons, collars, and embroidered patterns, along with capes and headwear. The background includes architecture like columns and arches, indicating a church or public building. A crowd of spectators is shown observing the event from windows and gathered in the courtyard. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or handheld objects, except for a baton or ceremonial staff carried by one of the figures. The composition reflects a structured and significant occasion with ceremonial characters.

artworks.title: Duel of Two Dwarfs
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals engaged in a sword duel. The image shows an energetic scene with each person holding a sword in a dynamic posture. On the left, an individual wears a hat and a coat with buttons and fur, standing defensively. On the right, another person is poised to attack, wearing a feathered hat and flowing garments. The detailed linework captures textile and texture details, suggesting movement in a flat surface illustration.

artworks.title: Dwarf Riding an Ass
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This image shows a person riding a donkey, accompanied by two figures. The drawing features an anthropomorphic donkey being ridden by a figure holding a long stick or spear, dressed in layered clothing with a plumed hat. The donkey is followed by another figure pushing a cart-like object, while another figure at the front is leading the way with the reins tied to the donkey's head. The lines are heavily stylized, creating a caricature-like quality evident in the exaggerated facial expressions and detailed attire of the characters. The overall appearance is whimsical and satirical, suggesting a humorous scene.

artworks.title: A Lady Greeted by a Dwarf
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals interacting. The central figure is an older person wearing elaborate clothing with a large hat and a feather, and a garment with fur-lined sleeves. This person has curly hair and a prominent nose, looking towards two others on the left who appear to be elderly, both cloaked with hoods or head coverings. To the right, a shorter figure wearing a hat and a cloak stands in front of another individual with a hat featuring long feathers. The latter has short hair and a beard. The background is plain, focusing on the characters. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Mercury Chasing a Satyr Holding a Book
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two mythical figures in a decorative setting. The central scene within an ornate, scrolling frame depicts two figures engaged in dynamic movement. One figure has the legs and tail of a goat and holds an open book raised high. The other figure is more humanoid and appears to be reaching out towards the figure with the book. Above them is a banner containing the Latin text "DABIS IMPROBE POENAS." The surrounding border features elaborate designs reminiscent of Baroque or Rococo styles.

artworks.title: The Fan
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image is an engraving with a grand scene within an ornate circular frame. The frame has elaborate scrollwork and figures along its edges. The horizon is about one-third down from the top, featuring tiny figures and distant cityscape elements. The middle ground shows crowds of people gathered, with billowing plumes suggesting activity or festivities. The engraving has fine and meticulous lines creating a play of light and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark contrast.

artworks.title: Fan
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with a detailed border. The illustration displays a hilly terrain with various buildings, fields, and trees. Ships can be seen sailing in bodies of water surrounding the land. The border features intricate leaves and floral designs, framing the scene. The drawing is labeled with the name "Federigo Federici" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Sheet of Etchings
artworks.medium: 4 etchings on 1 sheet of laid paper [restrikes]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of five small, separate scenes on a single sheet. Each scene contains a different interaction against a minimal, sketched backdrop with landscapes and architectural forms. Each panel suggests an engraved style through thin, etched lines defining figures and settings.

In the top left, a solitary figure appears amidst a simple environment. Adjacent to this scene, in the top center, a person stands near boats and a riverbank. In the top right, two costumed figures appear to be engaged in conversation. Below, to the right, is another dynamic interaction, where one figure carries an oar. The bottom left scene captures an older figure leaning on a cane, gazing out over a landscape.

artworks.title: Sheet of Etchings
artworks.medium: 3 etchings on 1 sheet of laid paper [restrikes]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: There are three separate panels of etchings. The top panel depicts a nude cherubic figure with distinct facial features and curly hair, holding a large hammer. The middle panel shows an adult figure walking with a bundle tied to a stick over the shoulder. The bottom panel shows an older person hunched over with a staff. Each panel features a figure in a different setting and role.
